criteria.camera: Any camera position/target/up/FOV/aspect change invalidates all blocks.
criteria.depth: Depth is the first contributing (non-zero scalar and opacity>0) sample in millimeters. Missing/empty rays use the maximum camera-to-volume-corner distance.
criteria.transfer_function: A transfer-function change invalidates every block that samples at least one non-zero scalar; all-zero-scalar blocks remain reusable.
criteria.union: Per-block categories are the union of all applicable change classes.
criteria.volume_edit: A block is invalid only when at least one pixel-center ray traverses a voxel cell whose edited scalar actually differs from the previous job.
